title: Operator sandbox RBAC: forensic audit + KMS escrow for investigatory flows
author: Priya Patel
description:
Context and motivation: After a live-incident postmortem (ENG-2154) we identified a recurring gap: operators needed time-limited, auditable investigative access to tenant data for fraud/abuse traces, and current RBAC/KMS flows were too coarse or required manual security operator involvement. This PR introduces an 'operator-sandbox' capability that provides temporary, least-privilege RBAC grants, a sealed forensic audit pipeline, and a KMS escrow path for ephemeral decrypt operations.

Summary of changes: Adds a new RBAC role template (operator.sandbox) with timebound grants and mandatory request metadata, a policy-compiler rule that enforces explicit consent and purpose tags for sandbox grants, an escrow manager in the KMS integration to create ephemeral escrow keys with operator provenance, and a forensic-mode audit writer that emits sealed envelopes containing operation metadata and an integrity hash. Region/residency constraints are enforced at grant-time and on any export of forensic artifacts (exports are pinned to customer's residency region). Includes migration tooling, a rollout plan (shadow rollout -> staged enablement -> forced on for high-sensitivity tenants), and an updated operator runbook.

Commits (summary): [1] add operator sandbox role template and tests; [2] implement policy-compiler checks for sandbox grants and purpose tags; [3] kms: escrow manager and ephemeral key lifecycle; [4] audit: forensic envelope writer + retention policy hooks; [5] migrations: DB schema for sandbox grants + CLI migration script; [6] e2e tests and CI fixtures; [7] docs and runbook updates.

Changed areas / high-level files: ["config/rbac/operator_templates.json","policy/compiler/sandbox_checks.go","internal/kms/escrow_manager.go","internal/audit/forensic_writer.go","internal/migrations/20260115_add_sandbox_grants.sql","cmd/cli/migrate_sandbox_grants.go","tests/e2e/sandbox_flow_test.go","docs/operator-sandbox.md","console/src/pages/security/SandboxGrantForm.tsx","observability/dashboards/sandbox-audit-overview.json","scripts/ci/fixtures/sandbox_kms_fixture.yaml"]. Small illustrative snippet: the policy compiler now rejects grants that lack 'purpose' or 'region_pin' tags - see policy/compiler/sandbox_checks.go.

Review conversation (high level): - Ethan Li: requested stronger guarantees that sandbox grants can't be implicitly escalated; asked for an additional enforcement in the policy compiler and a lint rule. (Author) Priya: added compiler-level deny for elevation paths and unit tests; explained approach in follow-up commit. - Claire Kim: raised privacy concern about forensic exports; asked that exports are region-pinned and require tenant opt-in; added requirement implemented in escrow_manager and console UI flag. - Marco Alvarez: asked for observability hooks and metric labels for sandbox actions; added metrics (sandbox.request.count, sandbox.kms.escrow_issued) and tracing spans. - Final approver (Ethan Li) approved after the added compiler checks and e2e tests passed.

CI summary: Full pipeline (unit + integration + e2e sandbox fixture) initially failed on e2e due to a timing race in the escrow TTL cleanup; fixed by adjusting the TTL watcher and adding a deterministic hook in tests. Final CI status: pass (linux-unit: pass, linux-integration: pass, e2e-sandbox: pass, linter: pass, policy-linter: pass).

Migration and rollout notes: - DB migration adds a sandbox_grants table; migration script is idempotent and reversible. - Default: feature is gated behind an account-level flag (security.sandbox.enable). Shadow rollout across 10% of operator tenants for two weeks to observe audit volume. Staged enablement for customers with SOC-2/HIPAA needs via sales onboarding. - Backout: a toggle in the console/admin API to revoke all active sandboxes and revoke escrow keys.

Security and privacy review notes: SEC review completed (SEC-498). Design principles: minimal privileged surface, explicit purpose and operator provenance, sealed audit envelopes with HMAC+KMS provenance, region pinning for all forensic exports, and automatic TTL-based revocation for both grants and escrow keys. Documentation and runbook updated; compliance owners signed off 2026-01-21.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged to main on 2026-01-22 after approvals. Release notes (short): Introduce operator sandbox RBAC with timebound grants, forensic audit envelopes, and KMS escrow for investigative decrypts. Admin feature flag and migration included.

Notes for reviewers post-merge: monitor sandbox.audit.volume and sandbox.kms.escrow_issued for unexpected spikes; trace any cross-region export attempts — these should be blocked and logged with reason code 'region-pin-violation'.
